Product_or_Service: Multilingual AI models, language data services, robotics and AI infrastructure

Target_Market: Critical infrastructure operators and defense markets in the Global South
Research_Notes: Company states it was founded in 2024. August 2026 announcement states the seed round closed at $52M after an additional $18M.

Product_or_Service: AI-powered logistics software, route optimization, automated dispatch and delivery analytics

Research_Notes: Official company site confirms AI-powered logistics platform and Nairobi presence. Latest reported funding was a $5M seed round led by Speedinvest.

Product_or_Service: AI and satellite-powered environmental data aggregation and analytics
Target_Market: Farmers, governments, corporations, financial institutions and supply-chain operators
Research_Notes: Official company source confirms Nairobi founding in 2022 and AI/ML environmental-data platform. $4M seed round reported in November 2023.

Product_or_Service: AI data acquisition, annotation, model fine-tuning and AI consulting
Target_Market: AI companies and organizations requiring training data and AI services
Research_Notes: Official site confirms AI data services and Accra delivery centre. Funding reports state $900K seed round and $1.15M total funding; founding year requires further verification.

Product_or_Service: AI-based digital booking, queuing, analytics and payments platform

Research_Notes: Company LinkedIn identifies Cairo headquarters, 2022 founding and AI-based customer journey platform. Funding source reports $3M seed round led by AHOY.

Product_or_Service: Industrial intelligence, machine learning and AI solutions for manufacturing
Target_Market: Manufacturers and industrial machine builders
Research_Notes: Official company source identifies Cape Town operations and roots dating to 2014. $10M Series A was completed in 2022.

Product_or_Service: Language AI and African-language speech and translation technologies
Target_Market: African businesses, financial institutions, nonprofits and organizations
Research_Notes: Public reporting confirms $2.5M funding and African-language AI focus. Founding year and latest funding date require further verification.

Product_or_Service: AI-powered digital stethoscope and tuberculosis screening technology
Target_Market: Public health systems, occupational health, clinics and healthcare providers
Research_Notes: Official company site confirms AI-powered TB screening technology. LinkedIn identifies Cape Town headquarters and 2020 founding. April 2026 funding reported at approximately $5.2M.

Product_or_Service: Arabic-first conversational AI, large language models and AI solutions for enterprises and governments
Target_Market: Governments and enterprises across the Arab world
Research_Notes: Founded in Egypt in 2017. The company later expanded into Saudi Arabia. The latest publicly announced round was $3M Pre-Series A in February 2025. The funding amount is recorded as the disclosed round amount rather than an assumed cumulative total.

Product_or_Service: Conversational AI, knowledge discovery and AI-powered digital assistants for customer and employee interactions
Target_Market: Enterprises and organizations across MENA
Research_Notes: Company states that its journey began in 2018 and reports $6.3M total funding. The latest major disclosed round was a $4M Series A led by Shorooq Partners and Algebra Ventures.

Product_or_Service: AI-powered aerial imagery, crop health monitoring, fruit measurement and yield forecasting
Target_Market: Commercial growers, packers, marketers and agricultural insurers
Research_Notes: Founded in Cape Town in 2014. Public sources report approximately $27M total funding, including a $17M Series B. The company uses AI, machine learning, aerial imagery and drone technology for precision agriculture.

Product_or_Service: Multilingual conversational AI, chatbot development, call-centre analytics and African-language technologies
Target_Market: Businesses and organizations serving multilingual African customers
Research_Notes: Company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Cape Town. Public databases identify a 2022 seed round, but a reliable publicly disclosed funding amount and lead investor were not established.

Product_or_Service: Cancer genomics, precision-oncology research, clinical data and diagnostic technologies
Target_Market: Healthcare, pharmaceutical and research organizations
Research_Notes: Founded in Accra in 2020. The company combines genomics, bioinformatics and AI-related technologies for precision oncology. Its official announcement confirms a $3M seed round led by V8 Capital.

Product_or_Service: Sensing technologies, MEMS, optical sensing, embedded systems and AI-enabled sensing software
Target_Market: Industrial, manufacturing, agriculture, automotive and technology customers
Research_Notes: Founded in Cairo in 2004. The company describes an AI-enabled software layer within its sensing technology stack. Wamda reported a $9M 2021 funding round and stated that total funding since inception had reached $19M.

Product_or_Service: AI-powered conversational commerce, automated customer engagement, marketing and social-commerce payments
Target_Market: African merchants and small businesses selling through social platforms
Research_Notes: Founded in Kenya in 2022. The company provides AI-powered conversational commerce tools for social platforms. A $1.2M pre-seed round was announced in September 2024 and led by PANI.

Product_or_Service: Arabic-native AI agents, voice and chat automation and customized AI applications
Target_Market: Businesses across Arabic-speaking markets
Research_Notes: Founded in Cairo in early 2025. Public reports disagree on the disclosed pre-seed amount, with different sources reporting $1M and $2M. The funding amount is therefore left blank pending stronger reconciliation.

Product_or_Service: AI-powered financing and lending platform for renewable energy businesses and customers
Target_Market: Renewable energy businesses and customers across Africa
Research_Notes: Founded in Nigeria in 2019 as Payhippo and later rebranded to Rivy. The company describes itself as an AI-powered lender focused on renewable-energy financing. The March 2025 round comprised $2M equity and $2M debt.

Product_or_Service: AI-powered SME financing, data-driven underwriting and revenue-based funding
Target_Market: E-commerce, retail, restaurant and other small and medium-sized businesses
Research_Notes: Founded in Egypt in 2022. The company uses AI-powered models and alternative data for SME underwriting. August 2026 reporting states a $34M Pre-Series A comprising debt and equity and total funding of $37.6M.

Product_or_Service: Arabic speech intelligence, transcription, analytics and AI-powered customer engagement tools
Target_Market: Enterprises, financial institutions, telecommunications companies and government organizations across MENA
Research_Notes: Founded in Egypt in 2021. The company builds AI models and speech technologies for Arabic dialects. The September 2025 Series A raised $12.5M and brought reported total funding to $16.9M.

Product_or_Service: Machine-learning-driven credit decisioning, financial analytics and API-based credit infrastructure
Target_Market: Banks, non-bank lenders and fintech companies across Africa
Research_Notes: Founded in 2019. Indicina provides ML-driven financial analytics and credit decisioning infrastructure. Public funding records show earlier funding plus a $3M June 2022 Seed round led by Target Global. Total funding recorded here reflects publicly reported rounds identified during research and should be treated as disclosed funding rather than an independently audited cumulative figure.

Product_or_Service: Digital pharmacy infrastructure, medication access tools and AI-assisted pharmacy and patient support
Target_Market: Patients, pharmacies and healthcare providers in African markets
Research_Notes: Nigeria-based digital pharmacy founded by Adeola Ayoola and Umar Faruq Akinwunmi. Google documents its AI care assistant and participation in the Google for Startups AI-First program. The company announced a pre-seed round led by Microtraction, but a reliable publicly disclosed amount was not established.

Product_or_Service: AI-assisted teleradiology, diagnostic reporting and remote radiology services
Target_Market: Hospitals, clinics and healthcare providers across Africa and the Middle East
Lead_Investor: Philips Foundation; Johnson & Johnson Impact Ventures; Sanofi Global Health Unit's Impact Fund; MIT Solve Innovation Future
Research_Notes: Founded in 2017. Rology provides AI-assisted teleradiology and remote radiology reporting. The December 2025 growth round had participation from Philips Foundation, J&J Impact Ventures, Sanofi Global Health Unit's Impact Fund and MIT Solve Innovation Future. The round amount was not publicly disclosed.

Product_or_Service: Enterprise AI infrastructure, temporal knowledge graphs, workflows and AI agents
Target_Market: Businesses seeking secure enterprise AI deployment
Lead_Investor: Founder Collective; Andrena Ventures; Cambridge Enterprise; Summit Ventures
Research_Notes: Cape Town-based South African AI startup. August 2026 reporting confirms a ZAR19.5M ($1.2M) pre-seed round. A reliable public source establishing the exact founding year was not identified.

Product_or_Service: AI-driven financial intelligence that converts business financial records into lender-ready data
Target_Market: Climate-smart businesses, lenders and financial institutions in Africa
Lead_Investor: Delta40 Fund I; Impacc; Argidius Foundation
Research_Notes: Nairobi-based Kenyan AI startup founded by Elana Laichena. The August 2026 pre-seed round was reported as undisclosed. The company uses AI to convert messy financial records into lender-ready data.

Product_or_Service: Coding, AI and technology education with an AI-powered personalized learning platform
Target_Market: Children and young people across Egypt and the wider Middle East
Research_Notes: Founded in Cairo in 2015. The company provides coding and AI education for young learners and is developing an AI-powered personalized learning platform. September 2026 Seed round raised $3M led by MRG Economic Group.

Product_or_Service: Edge AI infrastructure enabling machine-learning models and intelligent agents to run on low-power devices
Target_Market: African MSMEs, developers and organizations operating in low-connectivity environments
Research_Notes: Founded in Kenya in 2019. Fastagger develops AI infrastructure for low-power and intermittently connected devices. Public sources identify accelerator and non-equity support but do not establish a reliable cumulative funding amount.

Product_or_Service: AI-powered customer service, cloud communications and inbound/outbound customer interaction tools
Target_Market: Businesses and African SMEs requiring customer communication infrastructure
Research_Notes: Founded in Nairobi in 2019. Public company databases describe Dial Afrika as an AI-powered customer-service B2B SaaS company and report approximately $900K total funding. The latest round date and lead investor were not sufficiently established from stronger public sources.

Product_or_Service: AI-powered social chatbots for customer engagement, sales and business-process automation
Target_Market: African SMEs and organizations using WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook
Research_Notes: Company states that it was founded in 2020 and provides AI chatbot tools for SMEs. Earlier reporting documented the Ghana-based startup as bootstrapped and seeking seed funding. No reliable publicly disclosed funding amount or completed funding round was established during this research pass.

Product_or_Service: AI and data-driven infrastructure for informal food markets, market intelligence, trade coordination and agricultural supply chains
Target_Market: Governments, market associations, agribusinesses, farmers and traders across African markets
Research_Notes: Founded in 2018 and operating across Kenya and Nigeria. CoAmana develops technology, data and AI infrastructure for informal food markets. Public sources document a USD 500K Village Capital investment and a later USD 200K GIZ grant.

Product_or_Service: Real-time retail data intelligence for monitoring stock, pricing, competitor activity and consumer behaviour
Target_Market: Consumer brands, retailers and FMCG companies across African markets
Research_Notes: Nairobi-based retail data intelligence company incorporated in Kenya in 2024. Duck uses AI and real-time retail data to help brands understand stock levels, pricing and product performance. Public sources identify pre-seed funding but a reliable publicly disclosed amount was not established.

Product_or_Service: AI-powered impact data management, knowledge management, grant discovery and automated reporting
Target_Market: NGOs, development organisations, impact investors, social enterprises and other impact-focused organisations
Research_Notes: ReportsAI launched in 2025 and has a significant Nairobi/Kenya presence. The company builds an AI-powered platform for impact data, reporting and institutional knowledge. Antler provided publicly reported early-stage funding of USD 100K.

Product_or_Service: Fintech and data infrastructure for agricultural cooperatives, including payments and financial services for smallholder farmers
Target_Market: Agricultural cooperatives, farmers and agribusinesses across Africa
Research_Notes: Kenyan fintech and data infrastructure company focused on cooperatives and smallholder farmers. Public sources document earlier funding activity and participation in Google for Startups Accelerator Africa. The publicly reported cumulative amount should be treated cautiously because funding databases may not capture all non-disclosed support.

Product_or_Service: Digital transportation and tourism infrastructure using mapping, routing, mobility data and AI
Target_Market: Passengers, transport operators, tourism businesses and mobility users across African cities
Research_Notes: Founded in Tanzania in 2020 and headquartered in Dar es Salaam. Safiri develops digital infrastructure for transportation, routing and tourism. The company was selected for Google for Startups Accelerator Africa Class 10, which identifies it as an AI-driven African startup. No reliable publicly disclosed funding amount was established.

Product_or_Service: Digital financial services, payments, savings and alternative-data credit scoring for agricultural businesses
Target_Market: Smallholder farmers, agricultural cooperatives and agribusiness MSMEs
Research_Notes: Founded in Kampala in 2021. eMaisha Pay provides financial services for agricultural MSMEs and uses alternative data, psychometric analytics and machine learning for credit assessment. Public databases report approximately USD 650K in total funding.

Product_or_Service: AI-native transaction reconciliation, fraud detection and anti-money-laundering monitoring
Target_Market: Banks, fintech companies and financial institutions
Research_Notes: Lagos-based AI-native fintech platform. Google identifies MasteryHive AI as part of its 2026 African AI accelerator cohort. Public funding records identify Google accelerator support but do not establish a reliable disclosed cumulative funding amount or founding year.

Product_or_Service: Alternative-data credit scoring and digital-agent distribution for financial products
Target_Market: Unbanked individuals, micro-businesses and financial institutions in underserved African markets
Research_Notes: Lagos-based fintech using alternative data and AI-driven credit scoring for underserved individuals and micro-businesses. Public sources report accelerator and programme funding, but the available cumulative funding figure is not necessarily a complete representation of all capital raised.

Product_or_Service: AI-native communications infrastructure for reliable OTPs, transaction alerts, messaging and customer engagement
Target_Market: Banks, fintech companies, e-commerce businesses and digital platforms across Africa
Research_Notes: Founded in Lagos in 2017. Termii provides communications infrastructure and has evolved into an AI-native reliability platform. TechCrunch reported USD 3.65M in new financing in June 2023, bringing total funding to slightly more than USD 5M.

Product_or_Service: Multilingual AI infrastructure for translation, speech recognition, text-to-speech and generative AI across African languages
Target_Market: Businesses, developers, educational organisations and users requiring African-language technology
Research_Notes: Founded in 2023 and based in Johannesburg. Vambo AI develops multilingual language technology for African languages. Its public grants page documents support from the Mastercard Foundation, Meta Llama Impact Grant, UNDP Compute Accelerator and other programmes. Funding amounts are not consistently disclosed, so no cumulative amount is estimated.

Product_or_Service: AI-enabled energy management and optimization platform for commercial and industrial power systems
Target_Market: Commercial and industrial businesses, energy operators and organisations managing distributed power assets
Research_Notes: Lagos-based energy and climate-tech startup. Its Pai Enterprise platform uses AI to optimize distributed energy systems. A 2026 pre-seed round was led by Breega with participation from Catalyst Fund, Mercy Corps Ventures and Kaleo Ventures. The funding amount was not publicly disclosed.

Product_or_Service: AI model compression and long-context infrastructure designed to reduce compute, energy use and deployment costs
Target_Market: AI developers, technology companies and enterprises deploying large AI workloads
Research_Notes: South Africa-founded AI startup with a Durban connection and a US corporate base. Founded in 2025. Refiant develops compact, energy-efficient AI models and long-context infrastructure. It raised a $5M seed round led by VoLo Earth Ventures in April 2026.

Product_or_Service: AI-powered logistics marketplace, shipment intelligence and embedded trade-finance infrastructure
Target_Market: Businesses, SMEs, transporters and cross-border traders across African logistics corridors
Lead_Investor: Morgan Stanley Inclusive & Sustainable Ventures; Digital Africa Fuzé Fund
Research_Notes: Ugandan logistics technology company founded in 2017. Ridelink uses AI to predict carriers, routes and pricing and combines logistics data with embedded trade finance. Its November 2025 pre-seed round raised $1.1M; public funding databases report approximately $2.03M across disclosed rounds.

Product_or_Service: AI and cloud infrastructure that enables developers, startups and agencies to deploy GPU-powered AI tools from African data centres
Target_Market: Developers, startups, freelancers, web agencies and businesses building AI products in African markets
Research_Notes: Africa-focused AI infrastructure company founded by Luc Okalobé. Public reporting identifies a $100K initial investment from Felix Anane in 2025 and a subsequent pre-seed investment from Launch Africa Ventures in June 2026. The size of the Launch Africa investment was not disclosed, so the recorded total reflects only the publicly disclosed $100K amount.

Product_or_Service: AI-powered professional networking and knowledge-sharing platform combining video, community, scheduling and professional services
Target_Market: Professionals, experts, universities, accelerators and enterprise organisations
Research_Notes: Cairo-based AI-powered professional networking platform. BrainsMingle closed a $400K pre-seed round led by BasharSoft Group in June 2026.

Product_or_Service: AI-powered operational intelligence platform connecting business systems and identifying actions requiring attention
Target_Market: Manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors and retailers
Research_Notes: Cape Town-based AI software company founded by Rivar Maharaj. Tennsa OS acts as an operational intelligence layer across accounting, stock, payments and email systems. In August 2026, Oakvale Invest backed the company with more than $61K (ZAR 1M) in pre-seed funding.

Product_or_Service: AI-powered credit decisioning infrastructure using behavioural and transactional data to assess borrower creditworthiness
Target_Market: Banks, fintech companies, lenders and financial institutions
Research_Notes: Nigerian fintech company providing AI-powered credit decisioning infrastructure. Its technology uses alternative behavioural and transactional data to support lending decisions. First Ally Capital made an undisclosed investment in July 2026. The investment amount is therefore not estimated.

Product_or_Service: Arabic-native AI agents, workforce automation, customer engagement, document intelligence and enterprise AI APIs
Target_Market: Government organisations, financial institutions, healthcare providers, retailers and other enterprises across MENA
Research_Notes: Egyptian-Saudi AI company focused on Arabic and MENA enterprise automation. Public company materials document a $1.5M funding round and describe products for workforce automation, customer engagement and document intelligence. The precise round structure and lead investor were not established from the strongest available public sources.

Product_or_Service: Fleet management and vehicle intelligence platform using telematics, predictive analytics and risk management
Target_Market: Businesses, fleet operators and mobility companies across African markets
Research_Notes: Gabonese fleet-intelligence startup founded in Libreville. POZI uses telematics, predictive analytics and risk-management tools for vehicle fleets. It closed a €650K seed round led by Saviu Ventures in October 2025. The amount is left blank in the USD funding field because the publicly reported round was denominated in euros.

Product_or_Service: Multilingual voice AI infrastructure including speech recognition, text-to-speech, conversational agents and African-language AI models
Target_Market: Banks, fintechs, healthcare organisations, governments, enterprises and creators across Africa
Research_Notes: Founded in Lagos in 2021 as CDIAL and rebranded as Indigenius AI. The company builds speech and language AI infrastructure for African languages, including Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, Pidgin and Swahili. Cascador provided $250K in equity funding in June 2026.
